title: openstack-neutron-operator-kog values
description: Values for the OpenStack Neutron KOG chart. It emits one Krateo RestDefinition per Neutron resource (network, subnet, router, port, security group, security-group rule, floating IP) and a stateless openstacksdk auth-bridge that injects a fresh X-Auth-Token in front of the discovered Neutron endpoint.

restdefinitions.description: Per-resource RestDefinition toggles. Disable any resource you do not want generated.

enabled.description: Generate the RestDefinition (and CRD) for Neutron networks.

resourceGroup.description: Kubernetes API group for the generated CRD (GVK = <resourceGroup>/v1alpha1).

resourceKind.description: Generated CRD Kind. Prefixed Neutron* to avoid the crdgen Kind-vs-envelope-property collision.

authBridge.description: Stateless openstacksdk reverse proxy. It authenticates with a clouds.yaml, discovers the Neutron endpoint from the Keystone catalog, and injects a fresh X-Auth-Token on every request the rest-dynamic-controller makes.

cloudsSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret (same namespace) holding the admin clouds.yaml mounted at /etc/openstack/clouds.yaml. Create it with: kubectl create secret generic neutron-clouds --from-file=clouds.yaml=clouds.yaml. THE key install-time input.

osCloud.description: OS_CLOUD: which cloud entry inside clouds.yaml to use.

serviceType.description: Keystone catalog service type to discover (Neutron = network).

osInterface.description: OS_INTERFACE: which catalog endpoint to use (public, internal, admin).

upstreamEndpoint.description: Optional explicit upstream Neutron endpoint, overriding catalog discovery (e.g. http://neutron-server.openstack.svc.cluster.local:9696). Leave empty to auto-discover from the Keystone catalog.

image.description: auth-bridge container image (must contain openstacksdk + python3).

service.description: auth-bridge Service exposing the proxy in-cluster.

resources.description: auth-bridge container resource requests/limits (standard Kubernetes ResourceRequirements).

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the auth-bridge pod.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the auth-bridge pod.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for the auth-bridge pod.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the chart.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use; empty uses the default.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name portion of generated resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full generated resource name.
